title: SAP Delivers End-to-End Autonomous Enterprise with New Agentic AI
key_facts: SAP is launching new Joule agents and assistants at its Connect event in Las Vegas this week
Autonomous Enterprise strategy launched five months ago at Sapphire
Agents act across business processes, data and governance, aligned with customers' KPIs
SAP CEO Christian Klein: "a breakthrough moment for business AI"
SAP's Eric van Rossum says industry-specific scenarios will be the high-value ones
Uses Signavio for process mining and LeanIX for architecture
quote_evidence: In announcing SAP’s new Joule solutions, CEO Klein called it “a breakthrough moment for business AI” as customers now have the ability to “connect intelligence across every function to deliver trusted business outcomes.”

why_it_matters_hint: Cross-department agents are SAP's answer to AI that stays inside single tools.
